name: crm-lite-api-tests
description: CRM Lite orta katman (API) regresyon testlerinin Newman ile kosulmasi

scripts.test:smoke: newman run ../CRM-Lite.postman_collection.json -e ../environments/CRM-Lite.local.postman_environment.json --folder "00 - Smoke (on kosul dogrulamasi)" -r cli
scripts.test:local: newman run ../CRM-Lite.postman_collection.json -e ../environments/CRM-Lite.local.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/crm-lite-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "CRM Lite — Orta Katman Test Raporu" --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle "CRM Lite API Test" --reporter-htmlextra-showEnvironmentData --reporter-junit-export reports/crm-lite-junit.xml
scripts.test:strict: newman run ../CRM-Lite.postman_collection.json -e ../environments/CRM-Lite.local.postman_environment.json --env-var strictMode=true -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/crm-lite-report-strict.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "CRM Lite — Strict Mod Raporu" --reporter-junit-export reports/crm-lite-junit-strict.xml
scripts.test:ci: newman run ../CRM-Lite.postman_collection.json -e ../environments/CRM-Lite.ci.postman_environment.json --env-var baseUrl=%BASE_URL% --env-var password=%CRM_TEST_PASSWORD% -r cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/crm-lite-junit.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/crm-lite-report.html --suppress-exit-code
